research_question: Can S3 variants run reliably on four Vietnamese corpora and show competitive WEC-in, topic diversity and end-to-end topic-generation speed relative to LDA, NMF and BERTopic+UMAP+KMeans?
primary_metric: WEC-in using Word2Vec trained independently on each corpus
speed_claim_rule: Only pipeline_seconds and total_cold_seconds may support an end-to-end speed statement; fit_seconds is diagnostic only.
scope_rule: Each corpus is analyzed separately. Results do not establish a universal claim for all Vietnamese text or production performance.
negative_result_rule: All three S3 variants, all baselines, C_NPMI outcomes and failed configurations remain in the raw output and report.
